Subject: Vendor enrollment / MSA redlines and PO field mapping

Hi Connor,

Thanks for taking our call this morning. Attached are the MSA with our in-house redlines (BlueCrest_MSA_redline_v3.pdf) and the draft order form with the PO metadata our ERP will send to Ariba (OrderForm_BlueCrest_20261101.xlsx).

Two asks from procurement:
- Can Redwood confirm whether the "PO Line ID" and "RemitTo GL Code" fields will be preserved through the Ariba ingestion pipeline? We need those to flow into our AP system.
- Legal asked for a short summary of any MSA clauses that Redwood won’t accept as-is (we highlighted in red). If possible, can you share a high-level list and an estimated turnaround for comments?

We'd like to get enrolled in your Coupa/Ariba portal the week of Nov 15 so invoices can be accepted starting Dec 1.

Thanks — happy to jump on another 30-minute call if helpful.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Procurement Manager
BlueCrest Health

Markus / Kim — forwarding BlueCrest's packet. They want portal enrollment mid-Nov and have a couple of specific PO metadata asks.

Highlights / ask:
- They want assurance that "PO Line ID" and "RemitTo GL Code" will make it through our Ariba ingestion and into the customer's AP exports. I think this is largely an integrations/field-mapping question for the onboarding ops team, but legal may need to confirm retention of those attributes in our order acceptance pipeline.
- Legal redlines attached — ask from their counsel is to call out clauses we cannot accept and provide an alternative. I suspect this will be a small set (liability caps and data residency language).

Can you 1) review the MSA redlines for any non-starters and 2) confirm operationally whether the two mentioned PO fields can be preserved without custom work (or estimate effort if custom mapping is required)? If you prefer, we can do a short triage call Wed 11/4.

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Fwd: Vendor enrollment / MSA redlines and PO field mapping

Connor / Kim — quick pass from legal. I reviewed BlueCrest_MSA_redline_v3.pdf. Top-line:

1) Liability / Indemnity: BlueCrest proposes a significantly higher cap and a carve-out tied to regulatory fines. We cannot accept the proposed unlimited carve-out. Proposed counter: keep mutual cap at 3x average monthly fees (as in our standard MSA) and add a narrow carve-out for willful misconduct.

2) Data residency / access: They requested explicit EU-data residency guarantees and contractually binding third-party audits. Given they’re US-based and this is a standard hosted inference service, we can offer SOC2 evidence and a limited data processing addendum but cannot commit to specific regional residency without a Private deployment. Counter: DPA + option to discuss Private deployment for residency-sensitive workloads.

3) Insurance limits: they want a $10M per-claim minimum. We can offer $5M for standard sales motion; anything higher needs approval and notice to finance (may affect price).

Operational note (Kim): regarding the PO fields: our standard Ariba/Coupa ingestion pipeline preserves line-level identifiers but GL code fields are typically normalized into our billing metadata only when customers provide a mapping document. If BlueCrest will supply a field-map, we can persist RemitTo GL Code into the order metadata table. If they cannot provide a mapping, we can route to a manual mapping task (2-3 days ops effort).

Next steps I recommend:
- Connor: share a short, redlined-response summary back to BlueCrest with the three counters above (liability cap, DPA/private option, insurance).
- Connor + Kim: confirm with onboarding ops whether the field-map can be plugged into their Ariba adapter. If yes, provide the template to BlueCrest.
- If BlueCrest insists on residency guarantees, flag for Private deployment sales path and include a stub cost estimate.

I can draft the short legal response if you want.

—Markus
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 14:45:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Fwd: Vendor enrollment / MSA redlines and PO field mapping

Connor — operational confirmation below so you can include it in the reply:

- PO Line ID: preserved by default. Our Ariba adapter maps line identifiers into the order_line table and they are available in the invoice export. No custom work required.
- RemitTo GL Code: requires a supplied mapping. If BlueCrest provides the GL code to remit location mapping (CSV or their Ariba field map), we plug it in and the field will flow into our billing metadata. If they don’t have it, we can do manual mapping; estimate 2 business days of onboarding ops time plus a single test cycle.
- Acceptance criteria for portal enrollment: completed MSA (counters executed), signed order form, and our onboarding intake with the mapping template filled.

I'll attach the mapping template (csv) to your reply.

—Kim
Senior Onboarding Program Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@bluecresthealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 07 Nov 2026 17:28:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Vendor enrollment / MSA redlines and PO field mapping

Hi Samantha — thank you and the team for the redlines and the order draft. Quick summary and next steps so we keep to your desired timeline:

1) Legal counters (high level):
- Liability cap: we propose a mutual cap at 3x average monthly fees; will add narrow carve-out for willful misconduct.
- Data residency: we will provide a DPA and SOC2 evidence. For strict residency guarantees, the Private deployment path is required — happy to scope if needed.
- Insurance: standard offer is $5M; any increase will require finance approval and may change commercial terms.

2) Portal / PO metadata:
- PO Line ID: preserved by our Ariba adapter by default — no action required on your side.
- RemitTo GL Code: please provide a mapping file (CSV or Ariba field map). I’ve attached the onboarding mapping template from Kim to this thread for your use. If you cannot provide mapping, our ops team can complete manual mapping in ~2 business days (testing included).

3) Enrollment checklist & timeline:
- We need countersigned MSA (or executed counters) + signed order form + completed onboarding intake with mapping template to schedule portal activation.
- If we receive materials by Tue 11/09 EOD, we can target portal provisioning the week of Nov 15 and invoice acceptance beginning Dec 1 as requested.

If helpful, we can set a 30-minute call Tue 11/9 10:00 AM PT to walk the onboarding intake together. Please let me know your preferred slot.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: onboarding_mapping_template.csv (csv)
